reasons.reason: Initial baseline for the "code, not methods" gate (2026-10-24). The 231 findings are pre-existing scoring code in this public repo: 143 thresholds, 59 signal lists, 15 weight tables, 12 judgement prompts, 2 packaged constant imports. They are recorded so the ratchet blocks GROWTH while the debt is moved behind a seam or the repo is reclassified. Nothing new may be added without an explicit reason.
